speech_en: Cold doesn't bother me — but a hot pan does!
speech_de: Kälte macht mir nichts aus — eine heiße Pfanne schon!
scenario: Inside a cosy fridge: a cheeky short rod-shaped Listeria character in a knitted bobble hat and stripy scarf sits on a shelf enjoying the cold, its big bushy squirrel-like brush-tail (the actin comet tail, drawn as many soft wavy tangled strands) hanging from ONE end only, while a big friendly cooking pot with a face and billowing steam clouds waves it over for a very hot bath. Cheerful food characters — cheese, fish, milk carton, cold cuts, salami — stand on the shelves around them. The kids' teaching point (the fridge does not stop this one, but heating food right through does) is carried entirely by the picture and the speech line.
status: RENDERED — accepted on attempt 1 with gemini-3-pro-image. No starburst, no radiating rays, no motion or freeze lines, no frame/box/border line and no white margin band: the fridge shelves and wall panels are cut off by the edges of the square artwork on all four sides. Bold closed outlines, white interiors, every face cheerful; nothing gruesome and nothing scary. The brush-tail is attached to ONE end only and is drawn as a mass of soft wavy criss-crossing strands, never as rays or speed lines — matching the unipolar host-actin comet tail of the science styles. command: uv run --script .claude/skills/microbe-render/scripts/coloring.py --microbe listeria-monocytogenes --set pathogens-bacteria --prompt-file <this prompt> --model gemini-3-pro-image --attempt 1 --speech-en "Cold doesn't bother me — but a hot pan does!" --speech-de "Kälte macht mir nichts aus — eine heiße Pfanne schon!"
prompt:
A black-and-white CHILDREN'S COLORING BOOK page, square 1:1, 1080x1080. Composition must be SQUARE, never wide or landscape.

CRITICAL — READ FIRST: (a) the drawing must BLEED OFF ALL FOUR EDGES with NO frame, NO border line, NO box and NO white margin band; (b) there must be NO starburst, no radiating rays, no sparkle burst, no motion lines, no speed lines and no radiating lines of any kind anywhere in the picture.

SCENE: inside a big cosy refrigerator. A cheeky little Listeria character is having a lovely time in the cold, and a big friendly cooking pot has arrived to invite it to a very hot bath. Playful and reassuring, never scary.
- The LISTERIA character is in the middle-left of the picture, sitting on a shelf: a SHORT, CHUNKY, ROUNDED SAUSAGE-SHAPED ROD, only about two and a half times longer than it is wide, with smoothly rounded ends, lying on a gentle diagonal. It wears a little knitted bobble hat and a stripy scarf because it likes the cold. It has a BIG FRIENDLY FACE: two large round eyes with pupils, curved eyebrows and a wide cheeky grin, plus two tiny stubby arms. Its body is plain and smooth — NO bumps, NO knobs, NO egg shapes, NO spikes and NO segments anywhere on it.
- ITS BUSHY BRUSH-TAIL: attached to ONE END ONLY of the body (the lower-right end), a big soft BUSHY BRUSH-SHAPED TAIL, like the fluffy tail of a squirrel or a bottle-brush, drawn as MANY SOFT WAVY STRANDS packed close together and CURVING and CRISS-CROSSING over one another, fanning out into a rounded bushy shape a little longer than the character's body. Every strand is a separate SOFT CURVED LINE. The strands must be WAVY and TANGLED, never straight, never radiating outward from a point, never arranged like a fan of beams or a burst. Only ONE end of the character has this tail; the other end has nothing.
- THE COOKING POT character comes in from the lower right: a big chunky rounded pot with two handles and a lid tipped back, with its own cheerful face (two round eyes and a big smile) and two tiny waving arms. Three or four big simple rounded STEAM CLOUDS, each a plain closed bumpy cloud outline, rise from it and drift across the top of the picture. NO sparkles, NO stars, NO twinkles, NO rays coming off the pot or the steam.
- THE FRIDGE around them: big simple horizontal SHELF lines running right off the left and right edges of the square, with chunky cheerful FOOD characters standing on them — a fat wedge of cheese, a plump fish, a rounded milk carton, a stack of sliced cold cuts — each drawn LARGE and SIMPLE with its own happy face (two dot eyes and a wobbly smile) and big open white insides. Simple rounded fridge-wall panels behind them run right off the top, bottom, left and right edges.
- Everything is drawn LARGE, SIMPLE and CHUNKY, with generous open white areas inside every shape so a child can colour them in.

STYLE — coloring book line art:
- BOLD, THICK, EVEN BLACK OUTLINES on pure WHITE. Every shape fully closed.
- ABSOLUTELY NO shading, NO grey tones, NO hatching, NO stippling, NO cross-hatching, NO gradients, NO colour fill, NO solid black areas anywhere (eyes may have a small solid pupil only).
- Simple, cheerful, chunky cartoon shapes with plenty of white space.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN — the page is rejected if any of these appear:
- ANY decorative STARBURST, comic-style radiating burst, "pow"/impact star, sparkle burst, twinkle burst, sunbeam rays, radiating speed lines, motion rays, chill lines, freeze rays, heat rays or halo of rays behind, around or under any character. NO radiating lines of any kind anywhere. They leave a big empty shape that cannot be removed afterwards.
- ANY rectangle, rounded rectangle, square box outline, picture frame, panel edge, comic panel, border line, outer margin line, ground-line box, or vignette. The drawing must NOT sit inside a box of any kind. Do NOT draw a thin black line anywhere near the edge of the image. There must be NO white margin between the artwork and the image edge — the fridge shelves and wall panels are CUT OFF by the image edge itself.
- The artwork must BLEED OFF ALL FOUR EDGES of the square — the shelves, the fridge walls and the steam clouds run right off the top, bottom, left and right edges, with no white margin band and no enclosing outline.
- NO text, letters, numbers, words, captions, labels, signatures or watermarks anywhere.
- NO speech bubble, thought bubble or balloon of any kind (one is added separately afterwards).
- NO blood, no wound, no red marks, no sick, crying, frightened or angry faces, nothing gruesome, nothing scary.
- NO human figure and no hands.
